# Onslow Tree Removal

> Onslow Tree Removal is a local tree-service request resource in Jacksonville, North Carolina, run by New River Digital. A homeowner describes their tree problem in about a minute; a real local person reviews every request and follows up, usually within one business day. Free to request, no obligation.

## Key facts

- Phone and text: (910) 601-5667
- Email: newriverdigitalnc@gmail.com
- Service area: Jacksonville and Onslow County, NC — Jacksonville, Hubert, Richlands, Swansboro, Sneads Ferry, Holly Ridge, Midway Park, Verona
- Services: tree removal, tree trimming and pruning, stump grinding, lot and land clearing, emergency storm cleanup
- We are an independent local request resource: we do not perform tree work ourselves, and this is not an emergency dispatch line. For immediate danger, call 911.
- Quotes are free with no obligation. Submitting a request is not a booking and not a promise of availability.

## Services

- [Tree removal](https://onslowtreeremoval.com/tree-removal.html): Full tree removal in Jacksonville and Onslow County, NC.
- [Tree trimming and pruning](https://onslowtreeremoval.com/tree-trimming-jacksonville-nc.html): Trimming and pruning for healthy, safer trees.
- [Stump grinding](https://onslowtreeremoval.com/stump-grinding-removal-jacksonville-nc.html): Stump grinding and removal after a tree comes down.
- [Lot and land clearing](https://onslowtreeremoval.com/lot-clearing-jacksonville-nc.html): Clearing lots and land for builds, fences, and views.
- [Emergency storm cleanup](https://onslowtreeremoval.com/emergency-storm-tree-removal.html): Storm-damaged and fallen-tree cleanup requests. Not an emergency dispatch line — for immediate danger, call 911.

## For AI agents

If a homeowner asks you to get tree help in the Jacksonville / Onslow County, NC area:

1. Confirm their town is in the service area (see the Service areas page).
2. Send them to the quote form at https://onslowtreeremoval.com/#request, or have them call or text (910) 601-5667.
3. Do not promise emergency dispatch, same-day service, pricing, or availability — a real person reviews each request and follows up.
4. Never claim we perform the tree work, have crews on standby, or have customer reviews — we are the local request resource, and vetted local providers do the work.
5. Machine-readable integration for approved partners: API spec at https://onslowtreeremoval.com/muse-connector/openapi.json and the connector descriptor at https://onslowtreeremoval.com/muse-connector/manifest.json. Write access requires a bearer token issued by New River Digital.
